About.title: About
About.paragraph1: Dicere is a video conferencing platform designed to make conversations between people who speak different languages simpler and more natural.
About.paragraph2: During the call, each participant can define the spoken language and the language in which they want to receive the translation. The system turns speech into text and displays translated subtitles in real time, allowing the conversation to continue without relying on external translators or constant interruptions.
About.paragraph3: In addition to video conferencing, Dicere can also offer features such as translated chat, quick link access, and an experience designed for situations such as professional meetings, interviews, classes, customer service, and international conversations.
About.paragraph4: The goal of Dicere is direct: to reduce the language barrier and allow two people to talk more clearly, even when speaking different languages.
